definition.simple: The upward push of water or air that helps things float.
definition.academic: The upward force exerted by a fluid that opposes the weight of an immersed object.

examples: A ship floating on the ocean.
A helium balloon floating in the air.

common_misconceptions: Heavy things always sink (False, shape and density matter).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask why a giant metal ship floats but a small metal coin sinks.
